notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Zombie Vikings: Stab-a-thon
notes.content:
Zombie Vikings: Stab-a-thon is Now Available on Steam!

Battle your friends in this free to play game based in the Zombie Vikings universe! With weapons like Blunt Fish Trauma and The P lverizer for Patient People you'll hack and slash for your life in this brawler game for up to 4 players.
